name: Taiyou no Oishii Tabekata
original_name: 太陽のおいしい食べ方
source:
Being the sun isn't easy, is it!?
Satisfy the celestial goddess aboard the delicious boat of the sun god Ra!

Grow old, get swallowed, and be reborn... 
An absurd gourmet story of the Egyptian mythos!

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13373]Novelgame[/url]]
